guardSound: his dragging left boot squeaking on the floor

lines.burn: Boss, the tape is ash now. I burned the spool in the sink and pocketed the portrait.
lines.clientAfterBurn: Good, Owl. The past stays buried, and you will be paid by morning.
lines.clientAfterSend: You fool, Owl. You have ruined me, but the truth had to come out.
lines.clientAfterTake: You have it, good. Do not open it, do not linger. Get out of there now.
lines.clientCheckin: Owl, talk to me. Where is she, have you got clear of the hall yet?
clientIntro: Owl, it is Theo. I need that Laughing Widow portrait out of the Meridian tonight.
You get Marlow inside after closing, and I pay double, no questions asked.
One rule, boss to client. Never look inside the frame, just bring it to me.
lines.evidence: Leave Owl blinded in the alley, Theo says. Make sure he never sees who paid.
lines.evidenceAsk: Boss, that is Theo ordering the hit that took your eyes. What do I do with it? Burn it, or send it?
lines.guardFirstHeard: Boss, I hear his dragging boot squeak. It is the same sound from that alley night you went blind.
lines.marlowIntro: Boss, I am inside the foyer. I hear the radiators ticking and smell old polish ahead.
lines.outro: Boss, I am out on the street with the Widow. I can hear the traffic and breathe again.
lines.send: Boss, I mailed the spool to the papers. I kept a copy and I have the portrait.
lines.take: Boss, I lifted the backing and found a taped spool wired inside the frame.

lore.text: Theo is the client, boss. He was your partner once before he sold you out.
Milo is the guard, boss. He walks nights with a bad knee and a squeaky boot.
Madame Voss is the owner, boss. She built the Meridian to show her late husband's portraits.
The Laughing Widow is the item, boss. It is a small smiling lady everyone comes to see.
Theo is the voice on the spool, boss. He ordered the alley hit that blinded you.
Milo was a picture hanger here, boss. He knows every back hall like his own kitchen.
This is inspired by a 1911 case where a worker stole a famous smile portrait from a closed museum, boss.

rooms.describe: Boss, the entrance is quiet marble and humming lights, nothing moving yet.
rooms.name: Foyer

rooms.describe: Boss, I see a wide hall. I hear pigeons cooing in the vents and Theo's old matchbook by the bench.
rooms.name: Grand Hall

rooms.describe: Boss, I see rows of coats. I hear hangers clinking and smell mothballs and rain.
rooms.name: Cloak Room

rooms.describe: Boss, I see the Widow smiling on the wall. I hear the frame buzzing faintly and spot Theo's initials scratched behind.
rooms.name: Velvet Room

rooms.describe: Boss, I see dusty stairs and photo flashes. I hear my own steps ringing on metal rails.
rooms.name: Stair Gallery

tagline: Steal back the smile that blinded you.
title: The Missing Smile
